result.summary: Found several visual/layout issues, mostly related to a loading spinner stuck on a food image, cut-off content at the horizontal scroll edge, and minor inconsistencies in card layouts.

issues.description: A circular loading spinner is displayed over the Tokumaru Ramen Bar image, suggesting the image failed to load or is stuck loading.
issues.suggestion: Ensure images load properly and remove or fix the spinner state; add a fallback image or retry mechanism.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' horizontal card list is cut off abruptly at the right edge (Trattoria Piccolo card), indicating no clear scroll affordance.
issues.suggestion: Add a partial-card peek or scroll indicator to make it clear the list is horizontally scrollable.

issues.description: The category filter row (All, Pizza, Sushi, Burgers, Healthy) is also cut off on the right edge without a visible scroll cue.
issues.suggestion: Add fade-out gradient or arrow indicator to signal more categories are available via horizontal scroll.

issues.description: The heart/favorite icon on the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card is white on a dark background while the pizza card below uses a black circle background for the same icon, creating inconsistent styling.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite icon button style (background shape/color) across all promotional cards.

issues.description: The 'Popular right now' pizza restaurant card at the bottom is cut off by the screen/navigation bar, hiding its name and details.
issues.suggestion: Adjust scroll padding or lazy-load spacing so cards aren't obscured by the bottom navigation bar.
